sections.title: Sound of letter e
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (e) /e/. Its main sound is heard in the word (escuela) /esˈkwela/, which means school. This letter has one sound in Spanish. You make it clearly each time you see it. It never changes into another vowel. It stays short and pure in every word.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Spread your lips slightly and keep them relaxed. Move your tongue forward and raise it halfway toward the roof of your mouth. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. Put your hand on your throat. You feel your vocal cords shake because this sound is always voiced.

sections.title: Reading letter e
paragraphs: In open syllables, this letter gives the standard sound as in (mesa) /ˈmesa/. In closed syllables, you hear the very same clear sound in (el) /el/. You always read this letter aloud. It never becomes silent at the end of a word, as in (bebe) /ˈbebe/. In every position, the spelling gives one single vowel sound.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn this vowel into a diphthong like the sound in the word say. A diphthong is two vowel sounds in one syllable, where the sound glides from the first to the second. Keep your tongue completely still from start to finish. In unstressed syllables, do not weaken it into a schwa like the vowel in the word about.
